description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE JOB

We are hiring a Senior Software Engineer to design, improve, and maintain the core package set which supports software distribution throughout Anduril. This involves creating internal tooling, establishing standards, planning architectural changes, and supporting users of the package set. You are expected to provide expertise for the usage of Nix at a large scale and assist in training other engineers. You should be capable of operating autonomously with limited oversight in a complex environment, and have the ability to break down intricate problems into simple solutions.

 

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Maintain an internal package set in order to enable software distribution across the company for development, hosted services, and embedded devices

• Package open-source and proprietary software components using Nix

• Improve developer ergonomics by defining Nix usage standards, creating tooling support, and integrating with developer workflows

• Provide assistance, training, and mentorship to other team members

• Proficiency with Nix, Nixpkgs, NixOS, and functional programming generally

• Deep understanding of how build systems and packaging ecosystems work

• Ability to dive into large and complicated systems, and use Nix to improve them

• Experience with one or more of the following languages: Rust, C++, Go, Python, Haskell

• Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret security clearance

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Experience with managing cloud computing resources (eg: AWS)

• Experience with modern build and deployment tooling, and continuous integration (e.g. NixOS, Terraform)

• Experience designing complex software systems, and iterating upon designs via a technical design review process

• Familiarity with industry standard monitoring, logging, and data management tools and best practices

• A bias towards rapid delivery and iteration

title: Senior Manager, Customer Success Engineering
description:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

About the role
The Senior Manager, Customer Success Engineering leads a team of Customer Success Engineers responsible for driving measurable customer outcomes across Veeam Data Platform. This role balances strategic planning with hands-on execution leadership, ensuring customers realize value, improve resilience, expand adoption, and reduce renewal risk.
This leader is accountable for building scalable customer success engineering practices across onboarding, adoption, technical success planning, resilience maturity, executive engagement, and renewal readiness. The Senior Manager serves as a coach, operational leader, customer escalation point, and cross-functional partner to Sales, Renewals, Product, Support, Professional Services, and Technical Account Management.
The ideal candidate is a proven technical people leader with strong customer engagement skills, deep understanding of enterprise IT and data resilience, and the ability to translate customer business objectives into measurable technical outcomes.
What you’ll do

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of Customer Success Engineers, which may include junior managers, to deliver consistent, high-quality customer outcomes.

• Set clear expectations, performance standards, and operating rhythms for onboarding, adoption, success planning, resilience assessments, executive reviews, and renewal risk mitigation.

• Drive scalable technical capability across the team, including expertise in Veeam Data Platform, disaster recovery and resilience, cloud platforms, virtualization, storage, operating systems, and automation.

• Establish and improve standards for customer success plans, adoption roadmaps, account scorecards, health checks, quarterly business reviews, resilience reporting, and executive communication.

• Ensure Customer Success Engineers translate customer business objectives into co-signed, measurable success plans with time-bound value milestones.

• Champion resilience as a customer outcome by standardizing the use of maturity assessments, recoverability validation, recovery simulations, health checks, and gap remediation planning.

• Monitor customer health, adoption, sentiment, renewal readiness, and expansion indicators across the team’s book of business.

• Act as a senior advisor and escalation point for strategic enterprise customers, especially when resilience posture, executive alignment, adoption risk, or renewal risk requires leadership intervention.

• Partner with Sales, Renewals, Technical Account Management, Support, Product, and Professional Services to align customer success engineering activities with account strategy, product roadmap feedback, and revenue priorities.

• Build repeatable plays, enablement, and best practices that improve time-to-first-value, adoption breadth and depth, retention, expansion readiness, and referenceability.

• Drive continuous improvement in team operations, including capacity planning, account coverage, scorecard hygiene, forecasting inputs, and operating efficiency.

• Contribute to business planning by identifying growth opportunities, influencing account strategy, supporting expansion motions, and aligning team performance with retention and revenue goals.

• Ensure the team remains focused on advisory, adoption, resilience, and value realization outcomes while routing break

title: AI Marketing Project Manager
description:
Brief info about Vinted 

Our mission is to make second-hand the first choice, and we're looking for people who want to help us get there. Every day, we work together to help our members buy and sell pre-loved clothing and lifestyle items, giving each piece a second life - or even a third.
The Vinted Group is made up of three business units that support this mission:

Vinted Marketplace is Europe’s leading platform for second-hand fashion and a go-to destination for all kinds of pre-loved items, with a growing range of categories. Our platform connects millions of members across 20+ markets, helping great items find a new life.

Vinted Go enhances the shipping experience with a vast network of over 500,000 pick-up and drop-off points, partnering with more than 60 carriers across Europe, with added services like item verification for peace of mind on high-value pieces.

Vinted Pay is the newest part of the Vinted Group, dedicated to bringing secure, reliable payments to buyers and sellers across Europe. Seamlessly integrated into the Vinted app, it helps keep every transaction safe, efficient, and easy for our members.

Founded in 2008 in Lithuania, Vinted began as a way for friends to find new homes for clothes they no longer needed. In 2019, we became Lithuania's first unicorn! Today, our headquarters remain in Vilnius, and we've grown with offices across Europe, supported by a team of over 2,000 people. 

Information about the position 

We're building a program that brings AI and automation into how our marketing organisation works, across content, media, and brand. It touches a lot of teams and moves fast, and it needs someone at the centre keeping it all on track. That's you. You'll make sure our AI initiatives stay visible, on schedule, and joined up, without needing to be the most technical person in the room. You'll also get hands-on: helping colleagues build their own habit of using AI to work smarter, and running one of our workstreams yourself. You'll work closely with peers across Growth, Brand, Media, and Data teams, plus specialists embedded in each initiative you help coordinate.

In this position, you’ll 

• Keep our AI program's goals and progress visible across several workstreams, so nothing falls through the cracks.

• Own the reporting rhythm: automate what can be automated, chase what's overdue, and make sure our monthly business reviews are clear, timely, and followed up on.

• Spot when two initiatives are competing for the same time or resource, and flag it early.

• Run one of our workstreams yourself, coordinating contributors from across the business.

• Help non-technical colleagues build a real, personal habit of using AI in their day-to-day work, not just show them a tool once.

• Keep our documentation and backlogs organised and easy to find.

About you 

• Have a track record of building lightweight processes that different teams actually adopt, not process for its own sake.

• Have strong communication skills. You can get people who don't report to you to respond, follow through, and stay aligned.

• Comfortable in bringing order across the tools we actually work in (spreadsheets, Jira, Confluence, slide decks, Slack), turning them into something closer to a second brain than five scattered places to check.

• Have some grounding in how marketing actually runs, whether that's campaigns, content production, media, or brand, so you can speak the language of the teams you're coordinating and know a genuine blocker from a routine ask.

• Comfortable with working across a lot of different stakeholders and teams, without needing formal authority over any of them.

• Have genuine practice of using AI to make your work easier, automating admin, research, or reporting, whether that's through Claude Code, Cursor, or whatever tool you've made your own. We'll ask you to show it, not just describe it.

• Have excellent written and spoken English language skills.

title: Anime Illustrator
description:
Role Title: Anime Illustrators
Role Type: Contractor
Location: Remote
micro1 is engaging Anime Illustrators to contribute specialized knowledge on a customer’s advanced annotation project. In this role, you'll apply your expertise to help train next-generation AI systems. Your work will shape how models learn, reason, and perform through high-quality, real-world input. No prior experience in AI is required - your domain knowledge is what matters.
Scope of Work

• Annotate hand and finger landmarks/keypoints using MediaPipe-style hand topology, ensuring accuracy and adherence to strict guidelines.

• Identify and mark anatomical joints, including the wrist, MCP (Metacarpophalangeal), PIP (Proximal Interphalangeal), DIP (Distal Interphalangeal), fingertips, and thumb-specific joints (CMC, MCP, IP, thumb tip).

• Precisely place landmarks following defined annotation protocols and specified tolerance thresholds.

• Infer and accurately annotate partially occluded or visually challenging joints and landmarks, reasoning through complex hand positions and object interactions.

• Interpret a wide range of hand poses, orientations, and perspectives to ensure consistent and high-quality annotations across varied image and video data.

• Review visual feedback, identify deviations from requirements, and make targeted corrections to maintain annotation quality at scale.

title: Proposal Manager (Global)

title: Senior Analyst, Brand Strategy and Measurement
description:

With billions of queries across our platforms, we help people find their perfect flight, stay, rental car and vacation package. We're also transforming business travel with a new corporate travel solution, KAYAK for Business.

Our focus is on building the best travel search engine to make it easier for everyone to experience the world.

You'll be a key contributor to how KAYAK understands, measures, and improves brand marketing performance - partnering with marketing, media, analytics, and external measurement partners to generate insights that shape investment decisions and improve business outcomes across regions. This is a hands-on, cross-functional role for someone energized by turning complex data into clear stories and who wants their work to have a direct impact on how a global brand grows.

This position is required to work from our Norwalk, CT office 3 days per week.

 

IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

- Partner with regional marketing and media teams to define measurement priorities, establish KPIs, build learning agendas, and align measurement approaches with business objectives.

- Develop structured testing roadmaps across channels and campaigns, selecting the most appropriate methodologies based on the business question, available budget, and data availability.

- Own the day-to-day management and analysis of KAYAK's global brand tracking program, including vendor coordination, study implementation, and insight generation.

- Monitor key marketing and business performance indicators, identifying trends, opportunities, and risks across markets.

- Contribute to the evolution of KAYAK's measurement framework by identifying new methodologies, tools, and opportunities to improve how we understand marketing effectiveness.

PLEASE APPLY IF YOU HAVE:

- 4-6 years of experience in marketing analytics, measurement, paid media, strategy, or a related analytical function - ideally within a consumer technology, travel, or digital-first environment; equivalent experience, training, or transferable skills are also considered.

- Experience evaluating and optimizing marketing performance across digital and/or offline media channels.

- Familiarity with marketing measurement approaches such as incrementality testing, attribution, brand lift studies, or media mix modeling.

- Demonstrated ability to use data and analysis to influence business decisions and improve marketing performance.

- Proficiency in Excel and SQL for data analysis; experience with Python is a plus.

- Familiarity with marketing and analytics platforms such as Google Analytics, Adjust, Meta Ads

The Senior Records Manager will play a key role in assessing, redesigning, and strengthening EDA's Records Management Program to establish standardized, sustainable records and information management practices across EDA Headquarters and six regional offices.
This position will provide senior-level records management expertise with particular emphasis on digital and electronic records, records inventories and disposition, National Archives and Records Administration (NARA) requirements, process standardization, and the development of practical policies, procedures, tools, and training resources.

EDA administers economic development programs and grants designed to support economic opportunities and strengthen economically distressed communities throughout the United States. title: Lead Engineer (xAI Battery Storage)
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

Join the High Power Engineering team supporting xAI to design, build, operate, and maintain electrical infrastructure for AI training campuses. As a Lead Engineer for Battery Storage, you will work with a small on-site team to scale high-capacity power systems on a schedule set by compute demand. The position is based in Memphis, TN, with potential travel to other sites.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own the storage fleet as a power plant, not as an accessory: architecture, sizing, controls, safety case, and grid-forming behavior that lets the campus ride through compute step loads and generation contingencies.

• Own BESS architecture: pack-to-MV-transformer grouping, string composition, medium-voltage collection topology, string-level protection, and physical block layout including spacing per NFPA 855.

• Own sizing; translate compute duty cycles - step loads, training-job ramps, actual-versus-nameplate utilization - into power and energy requirements.

• Own inverter control strategy: grid-forming versus grid-following, droop and virtual inertia, fault-current contribution, ride-through, and coordination with generation governors and excitation.

• Own the plant controller and EMS functional specification: dispatch, state-of-charge management, peak shaving, spinning-reserve emulation, islanding, and black-start participation.

• Own the fire and life-safety case: UL 9540 and 9540A basis, thermal runaway propagation, deflagration venting, water supply, emergency response plan, and AHJ engagement.

• Own the OEM relationship: technical requirements, factory testing, performance guarantees, and degradation and augmentation planning.

• Direct Design, Commissioning, Ops/Build, Network, Civil, and Program Manager seats on Battery Storage as those seats fill.

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor's degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, physics, or another engineering discipline.

• 8+ years in power systems engineering.

• 4+ years directly on utility-scale or large commercial and industrial battery energy storage.

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCES:

• Experience sizing storage against a real duty cycle rather than a rule of thumb.

• Working knowledge of NFPA 855, UL 9540 and 9540A, IEEE 1547, and IEEE 2800.

• Utility-scale BESS fleet experience at large pack counts.

• Deep understanding of grid-forming inverter control and its interaction with synchronous machines.

• PSCAD or other EMT modeling of inverter-based resources.

• Professional Engineering license or intention to actively seek a PE license.

• Experience building and leading an engineering team from the first hire.

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Perform hands-on work in all environments (heat, cold, rain), in tight quarters or at heights.

• Work extended hours and weekends as needed to support construction, energization, and operations.

• Remain focused in hazardous environments while wearing appropriate PPE.

• Lift up to 25 lbs. unassisted.

• Provide 24/7 on-call support for emergencies.

• Willing to work on-site in Memphis, TN. This is not a remote or hybrid role.

• Travel up to 25% for factory witness testing, vendor and OEM engagement, and supporting other sites.

• Valid driver's license.

DESCRIPCIÓN GENERAL
Technosylva es una empresa SaaS líder en soluciones de soporte operativo y análisis de riesgos ante incendios forestales y fenómenos meteorológicos extremos. Nuestra misión es reducir el impacto de estos eventos mediante inteligencia proactiva y procesable que permite una mejor toma de decisiones.

Si bien están diseñados para satisfacer las necesidades de compañías eléctricas y agencias gubernamentales, están ganando rápidamente presencia en otros sectores, como operadores de transmisión, aseguradoras y nuevas industrias expuestas al riesgo climático.

• Designing and maintaining Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines, incorporating automated testing and security scanning.

• Reviewing infrastructure changes to ensure alignment with security, compliance, and engineering best practices.

• Working closely with DevOps, Security, and Development teams to improve platform capabilities and developer experience.

• Strong hands-on experience managing and automating Microsoft Azure infrastructure.

• Advanced knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code best practices.

• Experience implementing and administering HashiCorp Vault .

• Strong experience building and maintaining Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.

• Good understanding of Azure networking, identity, security, and governance services.

• Experience with service catalogues and self-service platform capabilities.

• Scripting experience using PowerShell , Bash , or Python .

• Solid understanding of DevSecOps principles and secure cloud architecture.

Experience

• Proven experience designing, building, and supporting enterprise cloud platforms within regulated environments.

• Experience integrating secrets management into CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience developing reusable Terraform modules for large-scale cloud deployments.

• Experience improving developer productivity through automation and self-service platforms.

• Strong collaboration skills, with experience working across infrastructure, security, and development teams.

Preferred Qualifications
The following certifications are desirable:

• Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104)

• Microsoft Certified: Azure DevOps Engineer Expert (AZ-400)

title: (Senior) Director UX, Operations
description:
About the role

HelloFresh is reorganising UX to work AI-native - practitioners either go deep as platform and skills experts, or broad as generalists who move fluidly across product, design and engineering to drive experience quality and innovation. This role leads UX for our Operations organisation: the part of the business that bridges technology with physical fulfilment, procurement, quality assurance and supply chain, across every market and brand we operate in.

You'll take over from a Director who spent two years shifting this function from reactive delivery to a high-leverage, AI-native strategic partner - including building an internal design platform, integrated with AI tooling, that other parts of the business have since adopted. You inherit that trajectory, not a finished product: some of our highest-stakes bets for 2026, including how we plan menus algorithmically at scale and how we run the internal tools that power supply-chain decision-making, are still being actively designed, not maintained.

This is a Berlin-based, in-person leadership role. Operations is one of several major, Berlin-anchored parts of our technology organization, and regular physical presence - with peers, with your team, and in the room for cross-functional decisions - is a deliberate requirement of how we want this function led going forward.

What you'll own

• UX strategy and quality across four core areas of Operations: menu planning and food systems (algorithmic menu planning, ranking, demand forecasting, assortment), fulfillment (production, order management, inventory, logistics, manufacturing, supplier reliability), an internal operations-research platform that runs dozens of optimization models across the supply chain, and the technology backbone that keeps our warehouses and production sites running.

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.
About the team
People Strategy & Enablement (PS&E) bridges the gap between strategy and impact. We create clarity and momentum for People initiatives, partnering cross-functionally to design and run scalable programs and products that improve decisions, reduce friction, and support sustainable growth. By enabling operational excellence and alignment, we ensure the People team can move faster and with confidence.
Our work spans five core areas: strategic planning and roadmap prioritization to ensure the People team focuses on the highest-value initiatives; pillar management to track health, risks, and progress of strategic initiatives with transparency and accountability; project management to provide the discipline and structure required to move initiatives across the finish line - from inception through delivery; design readiness and change management to prepare the organization to adopt and sustain new programs; and People operating rhythms to organize and facilitate planning cadences and forums that keep the organization aligned and moving.
The role
This is not a typical project management role. As Project Manager for People Operations Intake & Portfolio, you will own the systems, processes, and judgment layer that determines what the Partners, Operations & Insights (POI) organization works on - and in what order. You will be the connective tissue between the People team's ambitions and POI's capacity, serving as the first point of contact for all work requests flowing into POI's four core teams: People Solutions, People Data Analytics & Research (PDAR), People Partners, and Employee Relations & HR Compliance.
You will build and run Stripe 's POI intake and prioritization process end-to-end - from designing the intake experience for requestors, to triaging and evaluating incoming Jira tickets, to facilitating prioritization conversations with POI and People team leaders. As this function matures, you will expand into a broader portfolio intelligence role: the key strategic partner to all People team requestors, ensuring that the organization's most limited resource - team capacity - is always directed at the highest-priority work.
Critically, you will also build an AI agent to power and scale this work. You will design, iterate on, and deploy an intelligent intake assistant that helps with automated scoping, duplicate request detection, time commitment estimation, resourcing recommendations, and prioritization guidance - upleveling the quality of every intake interaction across the org.
What you'll do

Own and operate the POI intake process end-to-end. Manage the Jira-based intake system, ensuring all incoming requests are triaged promptly, routed correctly, and tracked through their full lifecycle from submission to delivery.

Serve as the primary intake partner for People team requestors. Act as a knowledgeable, approachable first point of contact who helps teams scope and frame requests well, setting clear expectations on timelines, effort, and likelihood of prioritization.

•

title: Sr. Director of Accounting

description:

The world’s most sophisticated companies rely on AlphaSense to remove uncertainty from decision-making. With market intelligence and search built on proven AI, AlphaSense delivers insights that matter from content you can trust. Our universe of public and private content includes equity research, company filings, event transcripts, expert calls, news, trade journals, and clients’ own research content.

The acquisition of Tegus by AlphaSense in 2024 advances our shared mission to empower professionals to make smarter decisions through AI-driven market intelligence. Together, AlphaSense and Tegus will accelerate growth, innovation, and content expansion, with complementary product and content capabilities that enable users to unearth even more comprehensive insights from thousands of content sets. Our platform is trusted by over 6,000 enterprise customers, including a majority of the S&P 500. Founded in 2011, AlphaSense is headquartered in New York City with more than 2,000 employees across the globe and offices in the U.S., U.K., Finland, India, Singapore, Canada, and Ireland. Come join us!

About the Team:

The AlphaSense Accounting team is responsible for safeguarding the integrity of the company's financial reporting and building the accounting infrastructure that scales with the business. We exist to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial statements; maintain strong internal controls; manage the close process and technical accounting matters; and serve as a trusted partner to leadership, auditors, and the board on all matters of financial governance and reporting.

We are seeking a proven, strategic, and hands-on accounting leader to serve as our Senior Director, Accounting. This role will be instrumental in partnering with the Controller to lead the core accounting operations as we continue scaling our high-growth SaaS business and prepare for public company readiness.

This leader, in partnership with the Controller and the CAO leadership team, will ensure the company’s financial foundation is strong, scalable, and fully aligned with the requirements of a future public company.

This is a highly visible leadership position requiring an experienced operator who thrives in high-growth environments, is detail-oriented, and can drive organizational maturity while maintaining agility.

• 15+ years of progressive accounting leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

• CPA and Big 4 public accounting experience strongly preferred.

• Demonstrated success leading accounting teams through IPO preparation and/or operating as a public company.

• Deep expertise in US GAAP and SOX compliance, and technical accounting, with strong awareness of public company best practices. 

• Proven record of building, leading, and scaling high-performing teams and implementing scalable systems and processes

• Strong business acumen with the ability to translate technical accounting into actionable insights for senior leaders.

• Exceptional communication, executive presence, and cross-functional partnership skills.

Leadership & Team Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing accounting organization with strong people leadership, accountability, and collaboration.

• Partner with the Controller and peer functional leaders (Technical Accounting & Reporting, Tax, Treasury) to align priorities and deliver on enterprise-wide initiatives.

• Build succession planning and talent development programs to sustain long-term team excellence.

Core Accounting Operations

• Own the monthly, quarterly, and annual close process with rigor, accuracy, and timeliness.

• Work with the Controller to develop a plan to reduce the month

title: Priority Initiative Leader, Strong & Safe Communities
description:
Stand Together is a philanthropic community that helps America’s boldest changemakers tackle the root causes of our country’s biggest problems, from education to the economy, broken communities, and toxic division, among dozens of other pressing issues. We provide our partners with access to resources including funding, thought leadership, a network of peers, and a playbook for applying proven principles to transform lives and society. 

As the Priority Initiative Leader for our Strong & Safe Communities portfolio, you will serve as the key strategic leader accountable for developing and refining the strategy and theory of change for how Stand Together and its network of partners shift the national paradigm on Strong and Safe Communities-from one that treats people as problems to be managed, to one that empowers citizens and communities as problem solvers.
This role sits at the intersection of movement strategy, coalition leadership, and organizational influence. You will bring together a complex and diverse set of stakeholders-including Stand Together organizations, philanthropic partners, nonprofits, donor partners, policy advocates, and community leaders-around an ambitious, comprehensive strategy designed to move the needle on a national scale. You will integrate the full breadth of Stand Together’s capabilities, from activations and storytelling to fundraising and partner development, to ensure our efforts are coordinated, compounding, and driving paradigm-level change.
The ideal candidate brings experience from a sizable and complex philanthropic or corporate environment and has a track record of shaping and executing strategies that cross organizational boundaries and produce measurable, durable impact. Done well, this role will accelerate a fundamental shift in how Americans think about, talk about, and tackle the challenges facing their communities.

Our Values: Working for an organization within the Stand Together philanthropic community is different from many other places. The culture is deeply rooted in Principle Based Management® (PBM®), a framework guided by the principles that drive human progress, such as dignity, openness, and bottom-up empowerment. PBM® empowers employees to be entrepreneurial, to innovate, and to continually drive transformation.   
 
We believe diversity fuels creativity, broadens knowledge, and helps drive success.  That is why we’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and strive to treat all employees and applicants with honesty, dignity, and respect.

title: Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (all genders)
description:
Deine Rolle

Als Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (all genders) bist Du die zentrale Ansprechperson für Fragen zum Thema Arbeits- bzw. Gesundheitsschutz und unterstützt unsere Führungskräfte bei der fachgerechten Umsetzung der gesetzlichen sowie internen Anforderungen an unseren Last Mile Logistikstandorten. Du berätst die operativen Bereiche bei der Identifikation sowie Beurteilung von Gefährdungen und wirkst somit an der Weiterentwicklung einer nachhaltigen Sicherheitskultur mit. Du unterstützt zudem bei der Ableitung und Umsetzung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen und trägst mit Deiner fachlichen Expertise dazu bei, ein hohes Sicherheitsniveau in unseren deutschlandweit rund 20 Zustell-Hubs sicherzustellen. 

Bitte beachte, dass für diese Tätigkeit eine Reisebereitschaft von ca. 90% sowie ein Führerschein der Klasse B vorausgesetzt werden.

Bitte beachte auch, diese Stelle auf 24 Monate befristet ist (eine anschließende Entfristung wird angestrebt).

Deine Aufgaben

• Beratung  der Führungskräfte und operativen Bereiche bei allen Fragen des Arbeits- und Gesundheitsschutzes sowie bei der Umsetzung gesetzlicher und interner Anforderungen zugeschnitten auf unsere Logistik Hubs

• Unterstützung bei der Ermittlung und Beurteilung von Gefährdungen, bei der Entwicklung geeigneter Schutzmaßnahmen sowie bei Dokumentation und Wirksamkeitskontrolle 

• Durchführung und Begleitung von Begehungen, Unfall- und Ereignisanalysen sowie Ableitung geeigneter Präventions- und Verbesserungsmaßnahmen

• Fachliche Beratung zur Einhaltung relevanter Anforderungen des deutschen Arbeitsschutzrechts, insbesondere ArbSchG, BetrSichV, GefStoffV, ArbStättV und des DGUV-Regelwerks

• Beratung und Coaching von Führungskräften sowie operativen Teams zur Gefahrenidentifikation, sicheren Arbeitsgestaltung, Wahrnehmung der Arbeitsschutzverantwortung und Förderung einer nachhaltigen Sicherheitskultur

• Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung von Sicherheitsprozessen durch strukturiertes Prozess- und Risikomanagement sowie Mitwirkung   bei Audits und organisatorischen Veränderungen 

• Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Fachstellen, insbesondere Brandschutz, Gefahrstoffmanagement, Fuhrpark sowie Behörden und Sachverständigen

Dein Profil 

• Abgeschlossene Ausbildung zur Fachkraft für Arbeitssicherheit (Sifa) bzw. Qualifikation nach ASiG und DGUV Vorschrift 2 oder Bereitschaft, diese Qualifikation zu erwerben

• 3+ Jahre Berufserfahrung im Bereich Arbeitssicherheit/EHS/HSE, vorzugsweise in der Logistik, Produktion, Distribution oder vergleichbaren operativen Umgebungen

• Fundierte Kenntnisse des deutschen Arbeitsschutzrechts und DGUV-Regelwerks, insbesondere ArbSchG, BetrSichV, GefStoffV und ArbStättV

• Erfahrung in der fachkundigen Mitwirkung bei Gefährdungsbeurteilungen, Begehungen, Unfallanalysen und Maßnahmenverfolgung

• Idealerweise fachliches Verständnis in den Bereichen Verkehrssicherheit, Flottenmanagement, innerbetrieblicher Transport, Brandschutz und Gefahrstoffmanagement sowie bestenfalls zusätzlich im Umweltrecht bzw. zu BImSchG 

• Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse (jeweils mind. auf C1 Niveau) sowie ausgeprägte Kommunikations- und Beratungskompetenz im Umgang mit operativen Teams

• Analytische, strukturierte und problemlösungsorientierte Arbeitsweise mit der Fähigkeit, komplexe Zusammenhänge in umsetzbare Sicherheitsstrategien zu überführen

title: Technical Co-founder (CTO) - AI Legal Front Desk
description:
The Opportunity
Solo practitioners and small law firms still lose work the same way: missed calls, slow callbacks, and intake handled between hearings. Hiring is no answer - payroll, training, and turnover are exactly what these firms cannot absorb.
Problem and solution validation are complete. Multiple live pilots are entering production evaluation. The next phase is proving in-production reliability, delivery economics, and scalability. The teams that ship credible AI workers into trust-sensitive verticals in the next 18 months will define the category. We intend to be one of them.
The Venture
BloomLex is a managed AI staffing platform that delivers AI workers as fully-set-up hires - trained, monitored, and continuously improved by our team. Rather than another self-serve SaaS tool, BloomLex operates as a Role-as-a-Service business: lawyers evaluate us on outcomes - time saved, calls answered, consults booked - not configuration effort.
Our first hire, Ava, is an AI Front Desk that answers calls 24/7, captures structured intake, books consultations, and performs outbound callbacks, without creating new operational burden for the lawyer. The roadmap expands from the front desk into adjacent AI staff roles, all delivered through the same managed model.
The Partnership
The CEO co-founder is in place. The customer thesis is validated, design partners are engaged, and live pilots are running. What remains is to bring on the technical co-founder - a partner who will own product and engineering with the same conviction, urgency, and ownership stake.
This is a co-founder role, not a CTO hire. In return for that level of commitment, you receive founder-level equity, founder-level authority with co-decision rights on product, technology, hiring, fundraising, and strategy, and a genuine partnership with the CEO on every material decision.
What you'll own
As Co-Founder & CTO, you will write the first lines of production code, set the technical direction, and lead execution end-to-end.

• Architecture & Reliability - Harden Ava's voice and workflow systems for in-production reliability. Establish core architecture, observability, and audit-trail standards

• RaaS Delivery Layer - Build the internal infrastructure that lets the team configure, monitor, and optimize AI performance without scaling engineering headcount

• Unit Economics - Own the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call, and lock in unit economics within the $499/month pricing model

• Customer & Market - Represent the company in front of lawyers, partners, and investors as the technical voice of the venture

• Roadmap - Convert pilots into paying customers, expand the AI staff beyond the front desk, and begin a path toward custom and self-hosted models where legal and privacy requirements demand it

• Team - Recruit and lead the founding engineering team, and establish the cultural foundation of the company

Co-Founder Profile

• Shipped LLM-powered and voice systems into production environments where incorrect outputs carried real consequences

• Full-stack confidence across applied LLMs, real-time voice and conversational AI, telephony, human-in-the-loop workflows, observability, and secure multi-tenant SaaS

• Well-formed convictions about reliability engineering, edge-case management, and the trade-offs between AI quality and cost-per-call

• Experience building managed and service-heavy platforms, with the discipline to scale delivery without scaling engineering headcount

• Prepared to operate as a principal - including saying "this won't scale" or "this isn't ready" when the integrity of the product requires it

title: Database Architect — Oracle & PostgreSQL, Cloud Migration
description:
OpsGuru is a global engineering and consulting group. We are experts in the container ecosystem, data processing and analytics, and cloud-native technologies. Our team is formed by network, data, security, DevOps specialists and application developers. OpsGuru empowers customers with technology to solve their business problems and provide the tools to assure success in their digital transformation.
About the role
We're looking for a Database Architect who owns the data tier end to end on enterprise cloud engagements - and who is equally deep in Oracle and PostgreSQL, because the work sits squarely between them.
Most of our engagements start with a working-but-aging system: an Oracle database carrying a decade of business logic in PL/SQL packages nobody has read recently, supporting applications that cannot go down. They end with a supportable, well-instrumented PostgreSQL platform on cloud infrastructure that costs less to run and that a managed operations team can actually keep healthy. Between those two points sit the decisions that determine whether the program succeeds: target-state design, sequencing, what gets converted versus rewritten versus retired, how cutover happens, and what the rollback looks like.
This is the person accountable for those decisions. You will set the technical direction for database migration and modernization work, defend it to client architects and executives, and stay close enough to the implementation to catch the problems early. It is an architecture role that has not stopped being hands-on - you are expected to open a plan, read a trace, and prove the point yourself rather than delegate the diagnosis.
You will also help shape how we deliver this work: reference architectures, migration patterns, estimation models, and standards that make the next engagement faster than the last one.
What you'll do

• Own the architecture of the data tier across migration and modernization programs - current-state assessment, target-state design, migration strategy, sequencing, risk, and effort - and be accountable for the outcome, not just the design document.

• Make and defend the hard calls: convert versus rewrite versus retire, RDS versus Aurora versus self-managed, single cutover versus phased coexistence, where to spend money on performance and where not to.

• Design Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migrations in full: schema conversion, PL/SQL to PL/pgSQL strategy, data type and collation mismatch resolution, query rewrite patterns, and the performance validation that proves the target holds under real load.

• Plan cutovers that minimize downtime - CDC-based replication, dual-run and output-comparison approaches, rehearsals, go/no-go criteria, and a rollback plan you would genuinely be willing to execute.

• Stay hands-on where it counts: diagnose performance problems yourself, read execution plans, isolate whether the bottleneck is SQL, schema, statistics, configuration, storage, or application access pattern, and land the fix with evidence behind it.

• Architect the database platform on cloud infrastructure - sizing, HA and failover topology, backup and recovery, patching and version strategy, encryption and key management, observability, and cost optimization.

• Define the operational model handed to managed services: runbooks, monitoring and alerting standards, escalation paths, and the health checks that catch problems before the client does.

• Act as the senior technical voice with clients - lead architecture and design sessions, present to client architects and executive stakeholders, translate trade-offs into business terms, and hold the line when a requested shortcut creates real risk.

• Support pre-sales and delivery planning: scope database workstreams, size effort, contribute to proposals and statements of work, and flag the assumptions that will break the estimate if they turn out to be wrong.

title: Security GRC Lead
description:
ABOUT MERCOR

Mercor's mission is to organize human intelligence to power the AI economy. We're a leading AI data company, building the layer between human expertise and frontier models. Millions of domain experts on the platform are paid over $4 million per day to train frontier AI models. Mercor's APEX benchmark family measures AI's real-world impact on professional work. Mercor Enterprise brings this same infrastructure to Fortune 500 companies: helping companies capture how their best people actually work, translating that expertise directly back into agents.

 

Mercor is creating a new category of work where expertise powers AI advancement. Achieving this requires an ambitious, fast-paced and deeply committed team. You’ll work alongside researchers, operators, and AI companies at the forefront of shaping the systems that are redefining society. Mercor is a profitable Series C company valued at $10 billion. We work in-person five days a week in our San Francisco, NYC, or London offices.

ROLE DESCRIPTION

You'll be the first GRC hire at a company that processes some of the most sensitive data on earth: training data, evals, and human-feedback pipelines for the frontier AI labs, plus payments and KYC for 300K+ experts. Compliance posture is a sales gate for every $50M+ contract Mercor signs. The audit calendar never ends.

This is not an audit-theater role. You'll own the operating cadence of a continuously-audited company: continuous SOC 2 monitoring in Vanta, the active ISO 27001 buildout, an annual KPMG-style customer audit every quarter, and a sub-48-hour questionnaire SLA. You'll write controls in code where it makes sense, push back on tools that fight you, and own the artifacts that close enterprise deals.

We use AI heavily in our own GRC work - Vanta has an MCP, our questionnaire bank is queryable, evidence is automated where the framework allows it. You should be comfortable using LLMs to draft, review, and respond at speed. If you've ever copy-pasted the same answer into 14 vendor questionnaires by hand, you'll appreciate not having to.

We're in-person five days a week at our SF headquarters, with first Fridays remote.

WHAT YOU'LL BUILD

- The Mercor compliance operating cadence: SOC 2 Type 2 (continuous), ISO 27001 (standing up now), and the next two frameworks customers ask for (HIPAA, FedRAMP Moderate, EU AI Act conformity - your call on sequencing)

- A customer-audit machine that responds to Anthropic, Google, Meta, NVIDIA, and OpenAI without burning out the security team - questionnaire SLA under 48h, KPMG-grade evidence packs on demand

- The third-party risk program - formal intake, recurring review cadence, evidence requirements - tied into procurement so vendors can't be onboarded around it

- Policy lifecycle owned end-to-end: version, attestation, exception handling, review cycle - not a SharePoint graveyard

- Controls-as-code where it makes sense: Vanta integrations, Wiz policy packs, Panther rules tied to SOC 2 CC categories, automated evidence collection

- Data-handling procedures: the customer-data-deletion gap, DSAR workflow, KMS scheduled destruction, offboarding handlers

- The internal trust narrative: customer trust pages, security one-pagers, executive-ready disclosure templates when something goes sideways

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

- 7+ years in security GRC, compliance engineering, or audit, with at least 2 years owning a SOC 2 Type 2 program end-to-end at a company under audit by enterprise customers

- You've shipped at least one ISO 27001 certification from kickoff to issued certificate, including Stage 1 and Stage 2 with a real registrar

- Fluent in Vanta (or Drata, Secureframe, Sprinto) at the integration and admin level, not just the reviewer UI - you've configured connectors, written custom tests, debugged broken evidence

- You've sat on the company side of at least one enterprise customer audit conducted by a Big 4 firm (KPMG, EY, Deloitte, PwC) on behalf of a frontier custom

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
Why Weave Exists

At Weave, our mission is to evolve how therapeutic knowledge is captured, transformed, and communicated throughout drug development. We do this by equipping human experts with AI instruments to enable drugs to be brought to patients as rapidly, safely, and inexpensively as possible.

The Weave Platform streamlines regulatory workflows from start to finish by intelligently, creatively, and effectively infusing every step with AI. Together with our customers, Weave is designing and building the AI workbench for the entire therapeutic lifecycle.

The Role & Your Mission
We are seeking our inaugural Forward Deployed Engineer , reporting to our Director of Customer Success. This is a unique and pivotal role that requires a person of uncommon skills and disposition. You will own technical implementation for our customers - configure Weave’s core “Regulatory AI Templates” with a combination of AI and your regulatory experience, lead complex integrations and map data flows, ensure early stage customer satisfaction, and enable customers with the basics of how to lead future configuration projects as they move out of their onboarding phase.
This role is heavily and directly engaged with customers and requires an ability to work effectively and efficiently with LLM prompts to produce high quality scientific/regulatory documents. It entails tight collaboration with customers and Weave’s GTM and Product teams.
What You'll Own

•
Customer template customization: Our core templates are a good place to start, but many of our customers require customization to accommodate their style, brand, modality, and scientific idiosyncrasies. You will work with customers to customize templates to their needs

•
Prompt coaching: Ultimately we want our customers to be self-sufficient in maintaining their templates. You will help them overcome trepidation and develop the ability and structure to do so.

•
Ecosystem integration: You will collaborate with diverse stakeholder groups spanning IT, Regulatory Affairs & Ops, and Medical Writing teams to architect seamless data bridges between Weave and critical enterprise platforms, including systems of record and publishing platforms

•
Handbook creation: You will document best practices and situational tips for technical implementation for internal and external purposes.

What You’ll Bring

•
Prompt Artist and Pragmatist: You have experience building repeatable prompt/template systems (not one-off chats), evaluating output quality systematically, you know how to effectively manage failure modes (hallucination, context limits) in high-stakes regulated documents.

•
Technical System Connector: You possess practical experience navigating REST APIs and Webhooks. You can parse API documentation, validate endpoints, and master various authentication flows with ease.

•
Scientifically Conversant: You’ve got scientific wherewithal. You’ve been involved with drug development, you’re an SME in something, and what you don’t know you can pick up quickly. You know what these mean: CMC, CSR, HAQ, ICH, IND, NDA, eCTD.

•
Customer Lover: You thrive on working with customers, helping them solve their problems, and finding success.

•
Outstanding Educator and Communicator: Educating isn’t a chore for you, it’s a joy. You love to see people “get it” and enjoy the craft of figuring out how to help them get there.

•
Builder: You relish uncharted territory and yearn to build a cabin in it (figuratively speaking).

• 5+ years experience in B2B SaaS or in bio industries (e.g., drug co., CRO/CDMO), ideally in technical/software roles

• Experience serving therapeutics, life science, or bio markets strongly preferred

• Drug-related (e.g., bio, chem) education preferred, advanced degree ideal

What We Offer
🎯 The opportunity to work at a modern, cutting-edge healthcare technology company devoted to meaningful positive impact on human life. Collaboration, velocity, and customer obsession are our baseline, demonstration

title: Payroll Coordinator*
description:
Standort: Frankfurt (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Corporate Services | Department: People & Culture | Vollzeit/Teilzeit: 80-100 % | Anstellungsart: Unbefristet

Sorge mit uns für eine zuverlässige Payroll und gestalte effiziente People-&-Culture-Prozesse bei Capco mit.

Die Rolle

Als Payroll Coordinator* (m/w/d) bist Du für die ordnungsgemäße, termingerechte und gesetzeskonforme Durchführung unserer Entgeltabrechnung verantwortlich.

Du agierst als zentrale Schnittstelle zwischen Mitarbeitenden, People & Culture, Finance sowie externen Payroll-Dienstleistern. Dabei stellst Du die Einhaltung arbeits-, sozialversicherungs- und steuerrechtlicher Vorgaben sicher und trägst mit Deiner strukturierten Arbeitsweise zu zuverlässigen und effizienten Payroll-Prozessen bei.

Neben dem operativen Payroll-Geschäft unterstützt Du bei Audits, Reports und People-&-Culture-Projekten und bringst Dich in die kontinuierliche Optimierung unserer Prozesse ein.

 

Deine Aufgaben

• Du koordinierst und begleitest die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern und stellst eine korrekte sowie fristgerechte Abrechnung sicher.

• Du pflegst und kontrollierst Personal- und Abrechnungsdaten in unseren HR- und Payroll-Systemen und erstellst Bescheinigungen, Auswertungen und Reports.

• Du bist Ansprechperson für Mitarbeitende und Führungskräfte bei Fragen zu Gehaltsabrechnungen, Steuern und Sozialversicherungen und arbeitest mit Behörden, Sozialversicherungsträgern und Finanzämtern zusammen.

• Du unterstützt interne und externe Audits und stellst die Einhaltung gesetzlicher Vorgaben, interner Richtlinien und Prozesse sicher.

• Du wirkst an der kontinuierlichen Optimierung unserer Payroll-Prozesse , an People-&-Culture-Projekten sowie an weiteren administrativen Aufgaben im People-&-Culture-Bereich mit.

 

Dein Profil

• Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung oder ein Studium mit Schwerpunkt Personalwesen, Finanzen oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

• Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Entgeltabrechnung oder Payroll Administration .

• Fundierte Kenntnisse im Lohnsteuer-, Sozialversicherungs- und Arbeitsrecht .

• Erfahrung im Umgang mit Payroll- und HR-Systemen, z. B. SAP HCM, Workday, ADP, DATEV oder vergleichbaren Systemen, sowie sicherer Umgang mit Microsoft Excel und MS Office.

• Eine analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise, ausgeprägte Detailgenauigkeit sowie ein hohes Maß an Vertraulichkeit, Integrität und Serviceorientierung .

 

Von Vorteil

• Erfahrung in der Zusammenarbeit mit externen Payroll-Dienstleistern sowie relevanten Behörden und Sozialversicherungsträgern.

• Erfahrung bei der Erstellung von Payroll-Auswertungen und Reports.

• Erfahrung in der Unterstützung interner oder externer Audits.

• Erfahrung bei der Weiterentwicklung und Optimierung von Payroll- und HR-Prozessen.

• Freude an der Zusammenarbeit im Team sowie die Fähigkeit, Aufgaben eigenständig zu organisieren, Prioritäten zu setzen und Fristen zuverlässig einzuhalten.

 

Warum Capco?

• Arbeite in einer kollaborativen, offenen und unternehmerischen Unternehmenskultur.

• Übernimm eine verantwortungsvolle Rolle in unserem People-&-Culture-Team.

• Nutze kontinuierliche Lern-, Trainings- und persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten.

• Arbeite mit unterschiedlichen Teams und Stakeholdern innerhalb unseres internationalen Unternehmens zusammen.

• Gestalte die Weiterentwicklung unserer internen Prozesse aktiv mit.

 

Wir bieten Dir ein attraktives, mitarbeiterorientiertes Leistungspaket, das Dich in unterschiedlichen Bereichen Deines Lebens und Deiner beruflichen Entwicklung unterstützt:

Benefits

• Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich.

• Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy.

• Bike Leasing Programme sowie eine Capco Benefits Card mit monatlicher Gutschrift i.H.v. 44 EUR.

• Regelmäßige Gesundhei
